tutorialVideo.title: How to Login Facebook ID with Cookie (Video Tutorial)
tutorialVideo.instructions:
1. Install "Cookie-Editor" extension in your Chrome, Brave or Edge browser.
2. Open https://www.facebook.com in a new tab.
3. Click the "Copy Cookie" button for your purchased account in FBStore.
4. Click the Cookie-Editor extension icon on Facebook, click "Import", paste the cookie, and click Import.
5. Refresh the Facebook page — you will be instantly logged in without needing a password!
